jobs.title: Cultural Resources - GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Cultural GIS Analyst for Civil & Environmental Consultants, Inc. (CEC), in our Indianapolis, IN office, you'll provide technical and analytical support for our cultural resources practice. You will work closely with project managers, scientists, and field personnel to develop GIS data sets, exhibits, and manage data across several different states. You may also be asked to assist several project disciplines beyond cultural resources, such as environmental, ecological, and solid waste. You'll gather, analyze, and integrate spatial data from varied sources GIS Analysts often use data sets from GPS, digital imagery, terrain data, boring and sampling locations, State Historic Preservation Offices, and CAD. You will also perform spatial analysis, compute environmental impacts, design and update GIS databases, assist application development teams for ESRI based workflows and Web applications, and create associated metadata. You may also assist in GPS operation and data collection in the field.

Bachelor's degree in Geography/GIS, Archaeology, or related degree
1+ years of experience using GIS technology in a professional setting
1+ years of experience in cultural resource management or related field
Full knowledge of data management and map/exhibit creation in Esri ArcGIS Pro
Full knowledge of geodatabase creation and management of geospatial data
Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of an integrated team
Demonstrated ability to proactively communicate, speak, and write professionally
Desire to work in a potentially fast paced environment, while maintaining scheduled tasks troubleshooting issues, and developing solutions
Experience with GPS field data collection and processing
Experience working in the ArcGIS online platform, including applications like Survey123 and Field Maps
Exposure to scripting and automation tools (such as Python)
Experience with access and utilizing SHPO databases

We have experts! CEC is consistently ranked as a Top 500 Design Firm and Top 200 Environmental Firm by Engineering News-Record
. We are looking for people who enjoy using their education and experience to solve difficult technical problems and work on interesting projects. You can accomplish this while working with a team of professionals who are equally motivated to provide high levels of service to our clients and to teach you along the way.

We have support! We have a variety of Employee Resource Groups, including CEC Community - focused on giving back to the communities in which we work; CEC Ignite - focused on helping professionals early in their careers to develop their pathway; CEC iDEA - focused on inclusion, diversity, equality, and acceptance; and CEC Women - focused on creating internal and external opportunities for women to network and leverage professional experience!

We care about our people! People and Culture are two of the five elements of our strategic plan. When you care about your people, they will want to grow a career with you - that is our goal. CEC offers you a small-firm work environment with large-firm opportunities. Not only will we help you develop professionally, but we will also provide an opportunity to become an owner of the firm and share in its success.

CEC offers a matching 401(k); profit sharing; a performance bonus; company stock; medical, dental, and vision insurance; short and long-term disability; tuition assistance; professional development; and work-life balance.

CEC is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in recruiting, hiring or promotion based on race, color, religion, sex (including sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, transgender status), national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other basis or characteristic prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law.

THIRD PARTY RECRUITERS

If CEC has not expressly requested recruiting services or contractually engaged with you for recruiting services on a specific position, any resumes or candidate profiles sent to CEC shall be considered unsolicited. Therefore, any such submissions will be considered property of CEC, with no associated fees due to your firm.

jobs.title: BFF-AFIRMS Data Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Description

This position has a term length of 2 years with the possibility of extension.

Location -
This role is in-person. Work primarily takes place at North Campus, Edmonton.

BFF-AFIRMS, (Best Future Forest: Advanced Forest Genomics and Integrative Resource Management System), is a transformative initiative aimed at digitalizing forest resource management and tree improvement in Alberta (AB), Canada (CA). This is a joint effort across the Government of Alberta (GoA), forest industry partners of Tree Improvement of Alberta, University of Alberta (UofA, CA), and Oklahoma State University (USA). The initiative seeks to integrate high-throughput genotyping, predictive analytics, and decision-making science to ensure responsible stewardship of forest genetic resources in the face of climate challenges, and the growing demand for sustainable forest ecosystems and products.

Working with the BFF-AFIRMS team, the Data Coordinator will join our interdisciplinary team and support the development of BFF-AFIRMS data/computing infrastructure, decision-making workflow, and user experience. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in data curation and governance, collaborating with the database scientist to design, test, and maintain a relational database that manages large volumes of genomic, phenotypic, climate and site information, and tree improvement data. As the primary interface between scientific computing and our diverse range of end-users and stakeholders, the candidate will also be responsible for optimizing data flow across various disciplines for tree improvement decision-making, and facilitating seamless communication within the project.

The candidate will have an understanding of data collection and management in genetics, genomics, scientific computing, as well as familiarity with tree improvement programs, breeding data, and forest genetic resources. A passion for working in a highly multi-disciplinary and collaborative environment to support forest genomics and tree improvement programs is essential.

Responsibilities

The BFF-AFIRMS Data Coordinator provides critical leadership and management for field and lab data systems within the BFF-AFIRMS project. This role is responsible for overseeing end-to-end data acquisition, implementing quality assurance and control (QA/QC) standards, managing the project’s data catalogue, and engaging with key external stakeholders across the Alberta forest industry and tree improvement communities.

Build and maintain working relationships with external organizations, including academic partners, forestry professionals, and policymakers, to support data sharing, integration, and adoption of BFF-AFIRMS tools.
Coordinate data acquisition, submission, integration, and access with BFF-AFIRMS stakeholders and external information systems, including Government of Alberta systems.
Manage and maintain the BFF-AFIRMS data catalogue, database documentation, metadata, and public data quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) materials.
Coordinate field and laboratory data QA/QC processes and work with the Database Scientist, Software Developer, and project team to implement data and metadata standards.
Lead the development and implementation of data management tools that improve internal data collection, processing, quality control, and management.
Develop and manage project workplans, goals, and objectives related to BFF-AFIRMS data management and tool development.
Provide guidance and support to end-users, including managing external database access requests and developing user resources.
Coordinate the development of SOPs, user guides, educational materials, and other resources to support tool adoption and build capacity within the Alberta forest industry and tree improvement communities.
Support data security by collaborating with technical staff on access controls, encryption, and other measures to protect sensitive tree improvement data.
Monitor database performance, troubleshoot issues, and support system reliability and availability.
Support BFF-AFIRMS communications and knowledge transfer activities, including workshops, AGMs, online publications, website content, social media, reports, manuscripts, and extension materials.

Qualifications

B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Plant Genetics and Genomics, Forest Genetics, Tree Improvement, Bioinformatics, Genomics, or a related field.
Greater than 3 years experience working with database administration and management of large-scale datasets, an understanding of genomic data and its integration with a relational database, and operational genetic improvement programs.
Excellent communication skills, both written and oral, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment, and to collaborate with biologists, tree improvement experts, industry practitioners and government officers.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience of working in a research or academic environment, particularly in the field of genomics or forest biology.
Experience with Project Management.
Experience with organizing and managing assets and space logistics.
A proactive approach to managing problems.
Ability to adapt and evolve as required.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to details.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.

Application Instructions

Click "Apply Now" to submit your resume and cover letter as one document.

This position is subject to all applicable terms and conditions of the collective agreement between the Governors of the University of Alberta and the Non-Academic Staff Association (NASA).

This position offers a comprehensive benefits package .

About Us

The University of Alberta, its buildings, labs and research stations are primarily located on the territory of Néhiyaw (Cree), Niitsitapi (Blackfoot), Métis, Nakoda (Stoney), Dene, Haudenosaunee (Iroquois) and Anishinaabe (Ojibway/Saulteaux), lands that are now known as part of Treaties 6, 7 and 8 and homeland of the Métis. The University of Alberta respects the sovereignty, lands, histories, languages, knowledge systems and cultures of all First Nations, Métis, and Inuit.

The University of Alberta is a community of knowledge seekers, change makers and world shapers who lead with purpose each and every day. We are home to over 14,000 faculty and staff, more than 40,000 students and a growing community of 300,000 alumni worldwide.

Your work will have a meaningful influence on a fascinating cross-section of people - from our students and community members, to our renowned researchers and innovators, making discoveries and generating solutions that make the world healthier, safer, stronger and more just. Learn more .

At the University of Alberta, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible hiring process for all candidates. If you require accommodations to participate in the interview process, please let us know at the time of booking your interview and we will make every effort to accommodate your needs.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those individuals selected for an interview will be contacted.

All University employees have a responsibility to foster a workplace that prioritizes safety in all its forms—physical, cultural, and psychological. This is achieved by promoting a safe environment, adhering to all safety laws, policies and procedures, completing all required safety training, identifying hazards and implementing controls, reporting incidents, and contributing to a culture of belonging and respect, while endeavoring to ensure that all colleagues feel valued and safe to express their thoughts, perspectives and concerns.

The University of Alberta is committed to creating a university community where everyone feels valued, barriers to success are removed, and thriving connections are fostered. We welcome applications from all qualified persons. We encourage women, First Nations, Métis and Inuit persons, members of visible minority groups, persons with disabilities, persons of any sexual orientation or gender identity and expression, and all those who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas and the University to apply.

The Faculty of Agricultural, Life & Environmental Sciences is a leader in teaching, research, and community engagement across diverse fields including food systems, sustainable resource management, human ecology, and environmental sociology. jobs.title: Senior Geospatial Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you a Geospatial Data Scientist looking to grow your expertise and make a difference on projects across the world?

You will join us as a Geospatial Data Scientist - a key member of our Geospatial Science and Digital Twins team, responsible for applying advanced analytical techniques to derive insights from its big data.

We are proud of the different clients, countries and types of project that we get the opportunity to experience. We have particular expertise in large scale masterplanning projects and enjoy a mix of scales and projects type and aim to ensure our team members experience a broad range of projects during their careers.

This is a permanent opportunity however we are open to candidates who wish to work on a contract basis (inside IR35).

Key Duties

Responsible for undertaking research and development into geospatial services and application of new technologies, development of automated solutions, including developing 3D virtual cities and digital twins, new data products, data science and insights services from the vast array of datasets.
Manage and juggle complex masterplanning projects, project managing spatial and non-spatial data governance procedures and processes.
Set GIS standards in data quality, accuracy and mapping, where we develop and disseminate standard GIS templates that feed into map making capabilities.
From time to time be called upon to conduct training on a local and global level, assisting other Buro Happold disciplines with their GIS (QGIS and or ArcGIS) training needs, whilst developing new and improved GIS templates, styles and symbology.
Managing bids for RfW (Requests for Work) which will include writing and developing new scopes to meet client requirements, estimating fee costs and developing plans, and covering resource for the project timeline.
Assist in developing web mapping solutions using AI and Machine Learning modules and tools, embedding geospatial datasets into gaming engines to demonstrate the capabilities of GIS solutions to clients using both open-source and proprietary software packages.

Your Skills And Experience

Experience in geospatial data analytics and insights concepts and ability to apply them, particularly experience deriving insights and patterns from big data using statistical methods and processes.
Proficiency in data science-related languages such as Python, R, Matplotlib, MATLAB, SQL, and C/C++, and experience in spatial data processing and management with a strong emphasis on developing SQL scripts or development of SQL code.
Experience in spatial data management tools and platforms such as python, ArcGIS, ArcPy, QGIS, Shapely, GeoPandas, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, GDAL, GRASS, scikit-learn, TensorFlow for geospatial data analysis.
Demonstrable experience in developing, setting up and configuring spatial databases such as PostgreSQL/PostGIS, MS SQL Spatial and any other big data platform like MongoDB.
Sufficient understanding of Vector Databases for the implementation of AI modules and techniques.
Experience in geospatial data ETL (extraction, transformation and loading) to a spatial data warehouse environment, with a strong emphasis on CAD/BIM to GIS data processing with experience using ETL tools to automate data processes and creation of streamlined workflows
Knowledge and experience in cloud computing technologies such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Oracle Cloud step-up, configuration and development of data analytics and insights solutions, as well knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and protocols
Familiarity with semantic 3D modelling capabilities and methodologies using 3D datasets such as LIDAR, Point Clouds, and other 3D models and objects.
Ability to train, calibrate and validate computer vision algorithms for feature extraction such as the use of OpenCV and FME, as well as an ability to communicate geospatial data analytics methodologies and insights to both technical and non-technical people.
Strong, complex problem-solving skills and self-starter.
Experience applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) to cluster and pattern recognition in textual information.

Qualifications

A graduate from a relevant technical degree qualification in Data Science related course, GIS/Computer Science. A masters degree or PhD would be an added advantage with 7 years' or more experience.

A place for everyone

Buro Happold values an individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of how you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.

Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds, and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.

We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment. We are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing differences allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.

Please let us know if there are any adjustments we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact recruitment@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

jobs.description:
Summary

Want to have positive impact working in diverse environments? Join us at IHS Sanitation Facilities Construction! We collaborate with American Indian Tribes to plan, design, and construct water, wastewater, and solid waste facilities. Visit www.ihs.gov/dsfc or email SFCJobs@ihs.gov. Position is eligible for the IHS Student Loan Repayment Program with selection based on IHS priorities and available funds.

A REAL ID will be required beginning May 7, 2025, in accordance with 6 C.F.R. 37.5 (2021).

Duties

Help

Total Compensation Package
- Check out IHS's outstanding total compensation package for this job:

Civil and Environmental Engineer Total Compensation | Pay (ihs.gov)

This position is being announced concurrently under Excepted Service/Merit Promotion Examining procedures. Please review vacancy announcement number IHS-26-HQ-13075720-ESEP/MP for eligibility requirements.

Responsibilities

The incumbent will be responsible for collaborating with American Indian Tribes to increase and maintain access to water, wastewater, and solid waste facilities by:

Providing direct operation and maintenance services to the Tribes and tribal Utilities.
Perform site visits to obtain condition of systems, location of mains, determination of local water pressures and plumbing layouts.
Prepare and review planning proposals, feasibility studies and engineering designs developed by technical staff
Provide training and technical assistance directly to the Tribes on procedures for sanitation facilities, operator certification and compliance with the Clean Water Act and the Safe Drinking Water Act..

Requirements

Help

Conditions of employment

Selectee may be subject to a probationary period

U.S. Citizenship is required

Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959

Must have a valid State Driver's License. It must be REAL ID-compliant.

This may be a designated position covered by Public Law 101-630, requiring contact or control over Indian children. Due to this requirement, the agency must ensure that persons hired for these positions have not been found guilty of or pleaded nolo contendere or guilty to certain crimes.

Confidential Financial Disclosure Form may be required.

Successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit www.dhs.gov/E-Verify/.

Must have a viable bank account at a financial institution for electronic direct deposit of salary payment.

Background Investigation Requirement

This position requires the successful completion of a federal background investigation as a condition of employment.

A background investigation is a standard process used by the Federal Government to verify an individual's identity, employment history, education, and other relevant information to determine suitability for Federal service.

Upon receipt of instructions, applicants must complete all required background investigation forms within five (5) calendar days of issuance. Timely completion is critical to avoid delays in processing or a determination of unsuitability.

Applicants are strongly encouraged to prioritize this requirement and to maintain regular communication with their assigned Personnel Security Specialist throughout the process.

Prior to the appointment, candidates must present two valid forms of identification. If one of the documents is a state-issued ID or driver's license, it must be REAL ID-compliant.

Qualifications

To qualify for this position, your resume must state sufficient experience and/or education, to perform the duties of the specific position for which you are applying.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer and part time experience. You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

Basic Requirement(s)
In addition, to the Basic Requirements, you must also meet the Minimum Qualifications stated below-

Degree: Engineering. To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential and integral calculus and courses (more advanced than first-year physics and chemistry) in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields and circuits; (f) nature and properties of materials (relating particle and aggregate structure to properties); and (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics.. OR
Combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the physical and mathematical sciences underlying engineering, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the engineering sciences and techniques and their applications to one of the branches of engineering. The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following:
Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT)1 , or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico. Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather or eminence provisions) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration. For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions.
Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)2 examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico.
Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A. The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A.
Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance. Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions. (The above examples of related curricula are not all inclusive.)

Minimum Qualifications

Your resume must demonstrate at least one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the Federal service obtained in either the private or public sector performing the following type of work and/or tasks: Experience in providing technical assistance and training to water, sewer, and sold waste system operators and managers; provides operational advice and support related to sanitation facilities; reviews sanitation facilities designs (plans and specifications) and provides recommendations regarding operational features.

OR
3 years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to a Ph.D. degree,

OR
Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree

OR
A combination of specialized experience and education that meets 100% of the qualification requirements for this position

You must meet all qualification requirements within 30 days of the closing date of the announcement.

Education

This position has an education requirement. You are strongly encouraged to submit a copy of your transcripts or a list of your courses including titles, credit hours completed, and grades. Unofficial transcripts will be accepted in the application package. Official transcripts will be required from all selectees prior to receiving an official offer.

Only attendance and/or degrees from schools accredited by accrediting institutions recognized by the U.S. Department of Education may be credited. Applicants can verify accreditation at the following website: https://www.ed.gov/accreditation.

If you are using foreign education to meet qualification requirements, you must send a Certificate of Foreign Equivalency with your transcript in order to receive credit for that education. For further information, visit https://sites.ed.gov/international/recognition-of-foreign-qualifications/.

Additional information

Additional selection(s) of candidates may be possible within 240 days from the date the certificate of eligibles was issued for this announcement.

Federal Employees earn annual leave at a rate (4, 6 or 8 hours per pay period) which is based on the number of years they have served as a Federal employee. IHS may offer newly-appointed Federal employees credit for their directly related previous non-federal experience or active duty uniformed military service. This credited service can be used in determining the rate at which they earn annual leave.

This position may be covered by a Bargaining Unit.

Recruitment or relocation incentives may be authorized. At least a one year service agreement will be required.

The Indian Health Service (IHS), National Health Service Corps (NHSC), And The Health Resources And Services Administration (HRSA) Have Student Loan Repayment Programs For Qualifying Health Disciplines. This Is a Competitive Process Separate From The Hiring Process. Opportunities For LRP Are Based On Agency Hiring Priorities And Availability Of Funds. For Additional Information Please Visit

For IHS - https://www.ihs.gov/loanrepayment/

You will be evaluated for this position in accordance with the OPM Merit Hiring Plan.

As part of the application process, you will be asked to provide short essay responses (200 words or less each) to the following four questions.

How has your commitment to the Constitution and the founding principles of the United States inspired you to pursue this role within the Federal government?
In this role, how would you use your skills and experience to improve government efficiency and effectiveness?
In this role, you will be expected to professionally and efficiently implement executive direction. Provide an example where you implemented leadership direction on a strategy or policy decision that differed from your own recommendation.
How has a strong work ethic contributed to your professional, academic or personal achievements?
Your responses are optional and will not be scored.
However, they may be reviewed by hiring managers and agency leadership (or designees) during the evaluation process.
You will be asked to certify that your responses are written in your own words and that you did not use a consultant or artificial intelligence (AI) tool (such as ChatGPT or Copilot).

Financial Suitability Requirement:
This position may require a review of the applicant's financial history as part of the personnel security and suitability

jobs.title: Environmental Air Quality Modeler
jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

At WSP, we are driven by inspiring future-ready pioneers to innovate. We are seeking an experienced Environmental Air Quality Modeler
to join our growing Environmental Team. This position offers the opportunity to work on complex air quality permitting, compliance, and modeling projects for a diverse portfolio of industrial clients throughout the United States.

This role is preferably based in our Columbus, Ohio office; however, qualified candidates may be located in any WSP office across the United States.
The successful candidate will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams nationwide to deliver innovative environmental solutions, support critical infrastructure and industrial development projects, and help clients navigate an evolving regulatory landscape.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in air quality permitting and modeling, sound project management skills, and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service while helping shape sustainable outcomes for our communities and environment.

Your Impact

Lead and support air quality permitting, compliance, and regulatory projects for industrial clients.
Prepare and review New Source Review (NSR), Prevention of Significant Deterioration (PSD), and other air permit applications.
Conduct air dispersion modeling analyses using tools such as AERMOD and other applicable modeling platforms.
Perform emissions calculations, emissions inventories, and air regulatory analyses.
Prepare semi-annual, annual, and other regulatory compliance reports.
Interpret federal, state, and local air quality regulations and provide strategic guidance to clients.
Coordinate with multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality environmental solutions.
Manage project scopes, schedules, budgets, and deliverables while ensuring technical excellence.
Build and maintain strong client relationships through responsive communication and trusted technical support.
Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, client engagement, and identification of new project opportunities.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to the continued growth and development of the Air Quality practice.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Meteorology, Environmental Science, or a closely related discipline.
5+ years of professional experience in air quality permitting, regulatory compliance, and environmental consulting.
Demonstrated experience with:
Air dispersion modeling.
New Source Review (NSR) permitting.
Prevention of Significant Deterioration (PSD) permitting.
Nonattainment permitting requirements.
Air emissions inventory development.
Title V permitting.
Regulatory compliance evaluations.
Air emission control technology assessments.

Experience performing PSD modeling using AERMOD.
Strong understanding of federal and state air quality regulations, policies, and emerging regulatory programs.
Excellent technical writing, communication, data analysis, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and client relationships simultaneously.
Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with both AERMOD and CALPUFF modeling platforms.
Existing professional relationships with state and federal regulatory agencies.
Experience working with the Texas, Ohio, Indiana, or Kentucky environmental regulatory agencies.
Air permitting and compliance experience within one or more of the following industries:
Utilities and Power Generation
Data Centers
Oil and Gas
Refining
Chemical Manufacturing
Industrial Manufacturing

Active participation in industry or environmental professional organizations.
Strong client management and business development experience.
Demonstrated ability to anticipate client needs and develop practical, solution-oriented recommendations.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Data Scientist - environmental engineering
jobs.description:
As a Data Scientist
at Brown and Caldwell (BC), a leading environmental engineering firm, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and deploying advanced analytics and machine learning models that solve complex water and environmental challenges. We are using modern technology to transform the way that water is managed across the country.

This Data Science role assists cross-functional teams with identifying and defining opportunities to use AI and ML in the water and wastewater industry. The role develops and deploys models, generative and agentic AI solutions, web applications, and geospatial analyses to extract insights from diverse data sources under the supervision and guidance of more experienced data scientists. The role also supports cloud-based application development and deployment for internal and external users in collaboration with multidisciplinary project teams. This role represents BC at conferences and in publications through technical presentations and papers. Work is performed under general supervision with limited autonomy.

This role is strategically important because it sits at the intersection of BC’s engineering expertise and the rapidly expanding digital future of the water industry. It brings advanced analytics, AI, machine learning, and real-time decision support into a field where these capabilities are becoming essential for our clients. Your work will directly impact our ability to build digital solutions that ensure a future of clean water, thriving communities, and environmental protection.

Responsibilities

Conduct complex data analyses.
Execute data science tasks such as exploratory data analysis, model building, statistical analysis, and feature extraction, and hyperparameter tuning.
Set up data storage systems, preprocess data and create compelling data visualizations in standard platforms.
Build and optimize machine learning models.
Follow DevOps best practices for model deployment.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs.
Present findings to internal stakeholders and support client-facing presentations.
Follow best practices for software engineering and version control.
Monitor and apply industry trends and research advancements in machine learning and applications in the water sector.
Flexibility to adapt and execute various additional assignments based on evolving needs.

Mentorship

May provide mentorship, guidance, support, and knowledge-sharing to help less experienced team members develop their skills and grow within their roles.

Skills And Competencies

Strong programming skills in languages such as Python and R, along with proficiency in relevant libraries and frameworks.
Proficiency in writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code with minimal oversight.
Strong communication skills and ability to present findings with some review and oversight.
Basic knowledge of water/wastewater/environmental engineering and science topics.

Experience

Typically, a minimum of 2 years of Data Science or related experience is required.
Typically certified in the SMS Framework, and progressing through the SMS competencies.

Preferred Experience

4+ years of related work experience.
Core Programming: High proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and SQL.
Experience developing and deploying generative AI applications, retrieval systems, and agentic workflows.
Experience building data-driven applications, APIs, web tools, and interactive user interfaces.
Experience developing cloud-based solutions and follow DevOps best practices for model and application deployment.
Experience with Azure platform, DevSecOps, and MLOps, specifically:
Azure Machine Learning Studio (managing experiments, model registry, endpoints).
Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics.
Azure Cognitive Services / OpenAI API integration.

Experience developing functional data processing workflows to transform raw data into reliable input for ML algorithms.
Machine Learning & Statistics: Solid understanding of ML algorithms (Regression, Clustering, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting, Neural Networks) and statistical concepts. Experience with Deep Learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
MLOps & Engineering: Demonstrated knowledge of software engineering principles, version control (Git), and best practices for writing clean, production-ready code. Experience with CI/CD for ML (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
IoT & Time-Series: Experience with streaming data processing and time-series forecasting, particularly for IoT and edge compute applications.
Experience with large language models, retrieval, and agentic workflow development.
Proficiency in cloud infrastructure and web application development.
Experience with geospatial data processing, spatial analysis, and interactive mapping.
Demonstrated ability to engage with clients to identify needs and effectively sell or position data–driven consulting solutions, including translating technical capabilities into clear business value.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
Excellent communication skills to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders, with the ability to explain complex model outputs to engineering leaders.
A passion for staying updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in data science and environmental engineering.

Education

A degree in computer science, engineering, or related field or equivalent experience is required.

Preferred Education

Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

Salary Range:
The anticipated starting pay range for this position is based on the employee’s primary work location and may be more or less depending upon skills, experience, and education. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Location A: $95,000 - $129,000

Location B: $104,000 - $142,000

Location C: $114,000 - $155,000

You can view which BC location applies to you here. If you have any questions, please speak with your Recruiter.

Benefits and Other Compensation
: We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee health, performance, and success which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time off and parental leave, paid holidays, 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, performance-based bonus eligibility, employee referral bonuses, tuition reimbursement, pet insurance and long-term care insurance. Click here to see our full list of benefits.

About Brown And Caldwell

Headquartered in Walnut Creek, California, Brown and Caldwell is a full-service environmental engineering and construction services firm with 50 offices and over 2,100 professionals across North America and the Pacific. For more than 75 years, we have created leading-edge environmental solutions for municipalities, private industry, and government agencies. We strive to be the company of choice—to our clients, who benefit from our passion for delivering exceptional quality, and to our employees, present and future, who share our commitment to client service, collaboration, and innovation. Join us, and you will find a home where you can do your best work, reach new levels of expertise, and enjoy exceptional development opportunities. For more information, visit www.brownandcaldwell.com

jobs.title: Senior Geospatial Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you a Geospatial Data Scientist looking to grow your expertise and make a difference on projects across the world?

This is a contract opportunity (inside IR35).

You will join us as a Geospatial Data Scientist - a key member of our Geospatial Science and Digital Twins team, responsible for applying advanced analytical techniques to derive insights from its big data.

We are proud of the different clients, countries and types of project that we get the opportunity to experience. We have particular expertise in large scale masterplanning projects and enjoy a mix of scales and projects type and aim to ensure our team members experience a broad range of projects during their careers.

Key Duties

Responsible for undertaking research and development into geospatial services and application of new technologies, development of automated solutions, including developing 3D virtual cities and digital twins, new data products, data science and insights services from the vast array of datasets.
Manage and juggle complex masterplanning projects, project managing spatial and non-spatial data governance procedures and processes.
Set GIS standards in data quality, accuracy and mapping, where we develop and disseminate standard GIS templates that feed into map making capabilities.
From time to time be called upon to conduct training on a local and global level, assisting other Buro Happold disciplines with their GIS (QGIS and or ArcGIS) training needs, whilst developing new and improved GIS templates, styles and symbology.
Managing bids for RfW (Requests for Work) which will include writing and developing new scopes to meet client requirements, estimating fee costs and developing plans, and covering resource for the project timeline.
Assist in developing web mapping solutions using AI and Machine Learning modules and tools, embedding geospatial datasets into gaming engines to demonstrate the capabilities of GIS solutions to clients using both open-source and proprietary software packages.

Your Skills And Experience

Experience in geospatial data analytics and insights concepts and ability to apply them, particularly experience deriving insights and patterns from big data using statistical methods and processes.
Proficiency in data science-related languages such as Python, R, Matplotlib, MATLAB, SQL, and C/C++, and experience in spatial data processing and management with a strong emphasis on developing SQL scripts or development of SQL code.
Experience in spatial data management tools and platforms such as python, ArcGIS, ArcPy, QGIS, Shapely, GeoPandas, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, GDAL, GRASS, scikit-learn, TensorFlow for geospatial data analysis.
Demonstrable experience in developing, setting up and configuring spatial databases such as PostgreSQL/PostGIS, MS SQL Spatial and any other big data platform like MongoDB.
Sufficient understanding of Vector Databases for the implementation of AI modules and techniques.
Experience in geospatial data ETL (extraction, transformation and loading) to a spatial data warehouse environment, with a strong emphasis on CAD/BIM to GIS data processing with experience using ETL tools to automate data processes and creation of streamlined workflows
Knowledge and experience in cloud computing technologies such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Oracle Cloud step-up, configuration and development of data analytics and insights solutions, as well knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and protocols
Familiarity with semantic 3D modelling capabilities and methodologies using 3D datasets such as LIDAR, Point Clouds, and other 3D models and objects.
Ability to train, calibrate and validate computer vision algorithms for feature extraction such as the use of OpenCV and FME, as well as an ability to communicate geospatial data analytics methodologies and insights to both technical and non-technical people.
Strong, complex problem-solving skills and self-starter.
Experience applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) to cluster and pattern recognition in textual information.

Qualifications

A graduate from a relevant technical degree qualification in Data Science related course, GIS/Computer Science. A masters degree or PhD would be an added advantage with 7 years' or more experience.

A place for everyone

Buro Happold values an individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of how you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.

Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds, and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.

We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment. We are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing differences allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.

Please let us know if there are any adjustments we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact recruitment@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

jobs.title: Environmental Air Quality Modeler
jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

At WSP, we are driven by inspiring future-ready pioneers to innovate. We are seeking an experienced Environmental Air Quality Modeler
to join our growing Environmental Team. This position offers the opportunity to work on complex air quality permitting, compliance, and modeling projects for a diverse portfolio of industrial clients throughout the United States.

This role is preferably based in our Columbus, Ohio office; however, qualified candidates may be located in any WSP office across the United States.
The successful candidate will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams nationwide to deliver innovative environmental solutions, support critical infrastructure and industrial development projects, and help clients navigate an evolving regulatory landscape.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in air quality permitting and modeling, sound project management skills, and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service while helping shape sustainable outcomes for our communities and environment.

Your Impact

Lead and support air quality permitting, compliance, and regulatory projects for industrial clients.
Prepare and review New Source Review (NSR), Prevention of Significant Deterioration (PSD), and other air permit applications.
Conduct air dispersion modeling analyses using tools such as AERMOD and other applicable modeling platforms.
Perform emissions calculations, emissions inventories, and air regulatory analyses.
Prepare semi-annual, annual, and other regulatory compliance reports.
Interpret federal, state, and local air quality regulations and provide strategic guidance to clients.
Coordinate with multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality environmental solutions.
Manage project scopes, schedules, budgets, and deliverables while ensuring technical excellence.
Build and maintain strong client relationships through responsive communication and trusted technical support.
Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, client engagement, and identification of new project opportunities.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to the continued growth and development of the Air Quality practice.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Meteorology, Environmental Science, or a closely related discipline.
5+ years of professional experience in air quality permitting, regulatory compliance, and environmental consulting.
Demonstrated experience with:
Air dispersion modeling.
New Source Review (NSR) permitting.
Prevention of Significant Deterioration (PSD) permitting.
Nonattainment permitting requirements.
Air emissions inventory development.
Title V permitting.
Regulatory compliance evaluations.
Air emission control technology assessments.

Experience performing PSD modeling using AERMOD.
Strong understanding of federal and state air quality regulations, policies, and emerging regulatory programs.
Excellent technical writing, communication, data analysis, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and client relationships simultaneously.
Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with both AERMOD and CALPUFF modeling platforms.
Existing professional relationships with state and federal regulatory agencies.
Experience working with the Texas, Ohio, Indiana, or Kentucky environmental regulatory agencies.
Air permitting and compliance experience within one or more of the following industries:
Utilities and Power Generation
Data Centers
Oil and Gas
Refining
Chemical Manufacturing
Industrial Manufacturing

Active participation in industry or environmental professional organizations.
Strong client management and business development experience.
Demonstrated ability to anticipate client needs and develop practical, solution-oriented recommendations.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

Notice To Third Party Agencies

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

jobs.title: Environmental Engineer (Tribal Utility Consultant)
jobs.description:
Summary

Want to have positive impact working in diverse environments? Join us at IHS Sanitation Facilities Construction! We collaborate with American Indian Tribes to plan, design, and construct water, wastewater, and solid waste facilities. Visit www.ihs.gov/dsfc or email SFCJobs@ihs.gov. Position is eligible for the IHS Student Loan Repayment Program with selection based on IHS priorities and available funds.

A REAL ID will be required beginning May 7, 2025, in accordance with 6 C.F.R. 37.5 (2021).

Duties

Help

Total Compensation Package
- Check out IHS's outstanding total compensation package for this job:

Civil and Environmental Engineer Total Compensation | Pay (ihs.gov)

This position is being announced concurrently under Excepted Service/Merit Promotion Examining procedures. Please review vacancy announcement number IHS-26-HQ-13075720-ESEP/MP for eligibility requirements.

Responsibilities

The incumbent will be responsible for collaborating with American Indian Tribes to increase and maintain access to water, wastewater, and solid waste facilities by:

Providing direct operation and maintenance services to the Tribes and tribal Utilities.
Perform site visits to obtain condition of systems, location of mains, determination of local water pressures and plumbing layouts.
Prepare and review planning proposals, feasibility studies and engineering designs developed by technical staff
Provide training and technical assistance directly to the Tribes on procedures for sanitation facilities, operator certification and compliance with the Clean Water Act and the Safe Drinking Water Act..

Requirements

Help

Conditions of employment

Selectee may be subject to a probationary period

U.S. Citizenship is required

Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959

Must have a valid State Driver's License. It must be REAL ID-compliant.

This may be a designated position covered by Public Law 101-630, requiring contact or control over Indian children. Due to this requirement, the agency must ensure that persons hired for these positions have not been found guilty of or pleaded nolo contendere or guilty to certain crimes.

Confidential Financial Disclosure Form may be required.

Successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit www.dhs.gov/E-Verify/.

Must have a viable bank account at a financial institution for electronic direct deposit of salary payment.

Background Investigation Requirement

This position requires the successful completion of a federal background investigation as a condition of employment.

A background investigation is a standard process used by the Federal Government to verify an individual's identity, employment history, education, and other relevant information to determine suitability for Federal service.

Upon receipt of instructions, applicants must complete all required background investigation forms within five (5) calendar days of issuance. Timely completion is critical to avoid delays in processing or a determination of unsuitability.

Applicants are strongly encouraged to prioritize this requirement and to maintain regular communication with their assigned Personnel Security Specialist throughout the process.

Prior to the appointment, candidates must present two valid forms of identification. If one of the documents is a state-issued ID or driver's license, it must be REAL ID-compliant.

Qualifications

To qualify for this position, your resume must state sufficient experience and/or education, to perform the duties of the specific position for which you are applying.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer and part time experience. You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

Basic Requirement(s)
In addition, to the Basic Requirements, you must also meet the Minimum Qualifications stated below-

Degree: Engineering. To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential and integral calculus and courses (more advanced than first-year physics and chemistry) in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields and circuits; (f) nature and properties of materials (relating particle and aggregate structure to properties); and (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics.. OR
Combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the physical and mathematical sciences underlying engineering, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the engineering sciences and techniques and their applications to one of the branches of engineering. The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following:
Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT)1 , or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico. Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather or eminence provisions) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration. For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions.
Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)2 examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico.
Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A. The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A.
Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance. Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions. (The above examples of related curricula are not all inclusive.)

Minimum Qualifications

Your resume must demonstrate at least one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the Federal service obtained in either the private or public sector performing the following type of work and/or tasks: Experience in providing technical assistance and training to water, sewer, and sold waste system operators and managers; provides operational advice and support related to sanitation facilities; reviews sanitation facilities designs (plans and specifications) and provides recommendations regarding operational features.

jobs.description:
Work Hours: 1st shift position – 8 am to 4:30 pm – Minimal overtime

St. Paul, MN 55114

11/02/2026 to 11/01/2027 ; May extend

Description

The Hardware Systems Engineer is responsible for the integration of Sentera sensors and hardware onto UAS (unmanned aerial systems) platforms. This position requires experience in systems engineering practices, mechanical design, UAS instrumentation, hardware testing/validation, as well as exceptional organization, attention to detail, and dedication to user success. The individual will support integration schedule planning and execution, mechanical design, and hardware product validation & testing. Responsibilities also include flight testing, creating internal and external facing product documentation, and level 2 engineering support.

Responsibilities

• Mechanical design of components related to Sentera sensors and hardware.
• Planning and execution of Sentera sensor and hardware integrations for new UAS platforms.
• Maintenance of existing Sentera sensor integrations.
• Planning and execution of Sentera hardware integrations for UAS platforms.
• UAS flight testing.
• Wire harness design, fabrication, and documentation.
• Internal engineering and production documentation creation & maintenance.
• User facing documentation creation & maintenance.
• Level 2 engineering support.
• Hardware and software compatibility testing of Sentera sensors, UAS platforms, and 3rd party post processing software.
• Creation and maintenance of engineering drawings and bill of materials.

Requirements

• BS in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering field.
• Proficient in CAD (minimum of 1 year experience, PTC Creo preferred)
• FAA Part 107 certification acquired withing three months of employment
• Experience with UAS (drones) platforms (preferred)
• Experience with Pixhawk autopilots (PX4 & Ardupilot)
• Experience with MAVlink (preferred)
• Strong mechanical aptitude
• Ability to interpret requirements independently
• Computer literate in Microsoft Office Suite
• Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
• Strong attention to detail
• Highly motivated
• Ability to work constructively within a team
• Exceptional communication skills

Additional Details

• Change management facilitation regarding documentation between engineering staff and production staff.
• Will become a point of contact between Sentera engineering teams and technology partner engineering teams.
• Will help create product improvement and sustainment criteria
• Will be a subject matter expert on Sentera sensors and hardware, their functions, and their applications.

Manager Notes

Would like to see candidates who are familiar with Pixhawk autopilot hardware, PX4 & Ardupilot flight stack firmware, and other MAVlink based systems. Must be willing and interested to learn about these systems. Needs to be able to learn how Sentera products work and how to make them compatible with UAS platforms.

Work Environment:
• Approximately 25% of the day spent on feet.
• Must be able to lift up to 55 lbs.

Travel:
• May be required to travel using a personal vehicle (as much as weekly based on season)
• May be required to travel as necessary for flight testing and validation

• First round: Interviews conducted via Microsoft Teams (virtual).
• Second round: In-person interviews; candidates must be willing to go onsite.
Work Location: Position starts onsite immediately.

jobs.title: Environmental Practice Leader Transportation & Natural Resource
jobs.description:
We Make Everything Around Us Better

At PRIME AE, that’s not a slogan, it’s how we work.

Every bridge, building, campus, park, and roadway we design exists to improve how people live, move, learn, and connect. Through architecture, engineering, planning, and consulting, we partner with clients to create thoughtful, practical solutions that leave communities stronger than we found them.

If you want your work to matter, and to be surrounded by smart, collaborative people who care about doing things the right way, you’ll feel at home here.

Who We Are:

PRIME AE Group, Inc.
( www.primeeng.com ) is a nationally ranked, full-service architecture and engineering firm driven by collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to strengthening the communities we serve. With a growing footprint of offices across the country and a diverse team of more than 550 professionals, we partner with public and private sector clients to deliver thoughtful, high-impact solutions across transportation, education, healthcare, municipal, federal, commercial, and recreational markets.

Our culture blends entrepreneurial energy with the resources of a scaled, multidisciplinary platform—giving our people the opportunity to shape meaningful projects while influencing the future direction of the firm. As PRIME AE continues to expand its capabilities, geographic reach, and leadership bench, this is an exciting time to join a team that is building momentum, investing in growth, and empowering leaders to make a lasting impact.

The Opportunity:

We are currently seeking an Environmental Practice Leader – Transportation & Natural Resources to join our Indianapolis, Akron, New Albany, Columbus, Cincinnati, or Louisville office.

The position may be structured as either an Environmental Project Manager or Environmental Practice Leader depending on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and leadership background.

This is an exciting opportunity for an environmental professional who wants to remain actively involved in technical project work while helping build and grow PRIME AE’s environmental capabilities. We are seeking someone with approximately 6–15 years of experience who brings a strong technical foundation in environmental services and an interest in taking on increasing responsibility for project management, client relationships, staff development, and team leadership.

In this role, you will initially work alongside PRIME AE’s Transportation and Natural Resources teams to deliver environmental services for infrastructure projects while helping establish and grow an environmental team. As the practice expands, you will have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility for managing staff, developing client relationships, supporting business development, and helping shape the long-term direction of the environmental practice.

You will collaborate with transportation, water resources, roadway, bridge, traffic, survey, and planning professionals on projects for state DOTs, local agencies, municipalities, and other infrastructure clients. The ideal candidate will bring experience in areas such as NEPA documentation, wetland and stream delineations, waterway permitting, natural resources, agency coordination, and environmental compliance.

What You’ll Do:

As an Environmental Practice Leader – Transportation & Natural Resources, you will serve in a hands-on seller/doer role that combines technical project delivery with the opportunity to play a key role in shaping and expanding PRIME AE's environmental practice.

You will perform and manage environmental work on transportation and infrastructure projects, coordinate with regulatory agencies and multidisciplinary design teams, and provide technical guidance throughout project development. Depending on your experience, you may lead projects independently or work alongside senior leaders while continuing to expand your project management and leadership responsibilities.

As the environmental workload and team grow, you will help recruit and mentor staff, coordinate resources, develop client relationships, support strategic pursuits, and establish processes that position the environmental practice for long-term success.

Key Responsibilities:

Perform and manage environmental services for transportation and infrastructure projects involving state DOTs, local agencies, municipalities, counties, and other public-sector clients.
Prepare, manage, and review environmental documentation in accordance with the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) and applicable state and federal requirements.
Prepare and/or review Categorical Exclusions, environmental technical studies and memoranda, environmental commitments, alternatives analyses, agency coordination documentation, and public involvement materials.
Conduct and/or oversee wetland and stream delineations, jurisdictional waters evaluations, habitat assessments, threatened and endangered species reviews, impact assessments, and other environmental field investigations.
Prepare and coordinate environmental permits, including Clean Water Act Section 404 permits, Section 401 Water Quality Certifications, state waterway and floodplain permits, and other applicable environmental approvals.
Coordinate with regulatory and resource agencies, including USACE, USFWS, IDEM, IDNR, Kentucky Division of Water, Ohio EPA, and other applicable agencies.
Collaborate with roadway, bridge, traffic, drainage, water resources, and other project teams to identify environmental constraints early and incorporate environmental commitments into project development.
Serve as an environmental project manager and/or technical lead on multidisciplinary transportation and infrastructure projects.
Develop project scopes, fees, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and technical approaches.
Monitor project schedules, budgets, quality, and client expectations.
Provide technical review and QA/QC of environmental documents, studies, permit applications, and other deliverables.
Maintain awareness of changing environmental regulations, agency procedures, and permitting requirements.
Build and maintain relationships with transportation agencies, municipalities, regulatory agencies, clients, and teaming partners.
Identify environmental project opportunities and support proposals, letters of interest, qualifications packages, interviews, and other pursuit activities.
Help forecast environmental workload and staffing needs as the practice grows.
Support the recruitment, mentoring, and development of environmental scientists, planners, and specialists as workload increases.
Help develop technical standards, quality-control procedures, and consistent project-delivery practices for the growing environmental team.
Support the expansion of environmental prequalification’s, certifications, and service capabilities.
Participate in industry organizations, conferences, agency meetings, and professional events.
Balance technical project responsibilities with client development and business development activities to help establish a sustainable environmental workload and backlog.

What You’ll Bring:

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Biology, Ecology, Environmental Planning, Natural Resources, Civil/Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
7+ years of progressive environmental consulting, natural resources, or transportation environmental experience.
Experience supporting transportation and/or infrastructure projects.
Working knowledge of NEPA, Clean Water Act Sections 404 and 401, wetlands, streams, natural resources, environmental permitting, and applicable state and federal requirements.
Experience preparing and/or supporting NEPA documentation and environmental technical studies.
Experience with wetland and stream delineations, environmental field investigations, and/or waterway permitting.
Experience coordinating with state and federal regulatory agencies.
Project management experience or demonstrated readiness to take on increasing project management responsibilities, including scopes, fees, budgets, schedules, and staffing.
Strong analytical, technical writing, communication, and organizational skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary engineering and planning teams.
Interest in mentoring others and helping build and develop an environmental team.
Ability and willingness to support client relationships, proposals, and business development activities.
Experience working with INDOT, KYTC, ODOT, FHWA, and/or local public agencies is preferred.
Familiarity with applicable Indiana, Kentucky, and/or Ohio environmental procedures and permitting requirements is preferred.

is seeking a Technical Partner
to help grow our Natural Resources practice, with a focus on supporting power, renewable energy, diversified energy, and technology sector clients across North America.

Location: this is a hybrid role and can be based out of any of our offices across the USA

This role will provide technical leadership in biological resources, ecological mitigation, habitat conservation, ecological restoration, and environmental permitting. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to clients developing and operating major infrastructure projects while helping expand ERM's market presence and technical capabilities.

As a Partner, you will combine technical expertise, client relationship management, and business leadership to build long-term client partnerships, develop new business opportunities, and mentor multidisciplinary teams. This is an opportunity to join ERM's global partnership and play a leading role in delivering complex environmental solutions for some of North America's most significant energy and infrastructure projects.

What You'll Do

Lead business development and client engagement activities within the Power, Diversified Energy, and Technology sectors.
Provide senior technical leadership for biological resources, ecological restoration, habitat conservation, and environmental permitting programs.
Support clients through project planning, permitting, construction, and operations phases.
Develop and grow key client relationships while identifying opportunities for additional services.
Mentor and develop technical staff and project managers.
Collaborate with ERM partners and service line leaders to support regional and national growth initiatives.
Drive project delivery excellence while meeting financial, safety, and quality objectives.

What You'll Bring

Required:

BS/MS in environmental science, engineering, or related field.
15+ years of progressive experience in environmental consulting.
Proven leadership in mitigation and ecorestoration, including endangered species and habitat conservation.
Deep understanding of conventional and renewable energy markets in North America.
Strong business development track record, generating and delivering multi-million-dollar programs.
Expertise in HCPs, and regional permitting.

Preferred:

Experience establishing mitigation banks and writing vegetation management plans.
Existing client relationships in the Power, Diversified energy and/or Technology sector that can be leveraged for growth.
Familiarity with utility commissions, regulatory agencies, and emerging sustainability trends.

Why ERM?

Equity Ownership: Be a shareholder in a purpose-driven, global firm.
